title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil drafter or drafting trainee (Sydney)
location: Sydney NSW (civil and structural drafting team)
content_text:
Costin Roe Consulting careers page (checked 13 Oct 2026).
HOW TO APPLY: We're always on the lookout for new people to join the CRC team. If you're interested in joining a dynamic and vibrant group of engineers, drafters, and consultants, send us an email with your CV attached. While we may not necessarily have positions currently available, we welcome all applicants and will keep your information on file for future roles.
Drafting Traineeship programs: Starting as an apprentice draftsperson you'll learn about civil/structural drafting and administrative aspects of CRC's engineering practice. Opportunity to be sponsored through a 4-year diploma of Engineering Drafting at TAFE and mentored by senior CAD draftspeople.
Graduate roles and drafting positions are listed pathways. Civil engineering service covers site and stormwater drainage, roadworks and civil documentation for commercial, industrial and residential projects.
Published application email: mail@costinroe.com.au
Phone: +61 2 9251 7699
apply_instructions: Email CV (and cover letter) to mail@costinroe.com.au as stated on https://costinroe.com.au/careers/
